item.title: CVE-2026-79988 · 8.7 HIGH — Authenticated RCE through Twig sandbox escape
item.description: The Twig sandbox mechanism in Craft CMS is configured to allow dangerous functionality from the Yii framework, leading to authenticated RCE similar to previously disclosed vulnerabilities.
